visual_connections.description: CLI deploys code to the deployment web service running on EC2.
EC2 deployment service stores and tracks deployment state in DynamoDB.
EC2 deployment service queues deployment requests onto SQS.
Backend EC2 worker service pulls deployment requests from SQS.
EC2 worker service creates/deploys the customer Lambda function across the account boundary.
Browser sends invocation requests to Atlassian's internal EC2 service.
Internal EC2 service invokes the customer Lambda function in the customer account.
